notes: NFe renders the six providers with values null, the node capture, the graph handle, the select field slices, the dialog slices and the seat report; the outer Box carries the measured window budget and the inner Box the wheel handler when a cue is present.
The budget is the pane measurement clamped to the terminal rows, or the settled-budget store when the measurement is null; the settled value is debounced through `HG` and written back with `Z1.set`.
The content node is TFe with columns = max(0, columns - 5), the five-column fold handle; offset comes from RFe.
The toggle and focus actions register in the Chat context and answer false while nothing is drawn; the three context handler tables register only while their context holds focus.
onHoldsBandChange reports `holds && !isMultiLine(hostRows)` on mount and false on unmount.
